messages.text: Why is the boron that high, Dave? You are making power through a wall of it. Dilute, or tell me what the plan is.
Boron is basically gone. I am not saying the rods are doing all the work, I am saying the rods are doing ALL the work.
You have put us in the xenon pit. Nothing is going critical for hours. Go and make a cup of tea, it is the only thing that will happen quickly.
Xenon is climbing. It always arrives like a bad tenant: quietly, then all at once. Maybe do not trip anything in the next day.
I have just had three phone calls and a very polite email from head office. That was a scram, was it? Lovely. Write it up.
Turbine hall here. Something has gone clunk and then stopped, which is the worst order for it to happen in. Come and look.
She is overspeeding! The rotor is doing what rotors do when you drop the load: it is delighted. Close the stop valve before it leaves the building.
You have fallen out of step with the grid. We have a lot of people with kettles on, and now none of them is yours.
Steam generator level is low and getting lower. I would call that dry, but only if I were being rude to the steam generator.
The condenser vacuum is going. Check the pumps and the cooling water, or the turbine will cheerfully trip itself to make the point.
Your frequency is wandering off 50 hertz. Every clock in the country is about to be a few seconds wrong and I would like it not to be you.
Breaker closed, we are on the grid, and the tea urn is humming. Good work. Do not touch anything for five minutes.
New load request is on the tablet. We would take it as a personal favour if the number on the screen matched the number in the generator.
That was the exact megawatts we asked for. I may frame this. Nobody ever delivers what they promise on the phone.
We were short. Not by a disaster, just by enough for me to have a stern conversation with a spreadsheet. Please do better next call.
Three in a row delivered. Head office is calling it a trend. I am calling it luck, and I will not tell them.
The reactor has been sitting at zero for a while. I appreciate that you are thinking deeply, but a plant is a thing that makes power.
We are over one hundred percent. I admire the ambition. I would like it back down before anybody important reads the chart.
The shift clock is running very fast. Whatever you are doing, please do it a little slower: the plant has to live through it.
